standard.title: Standard
items: Import `FaqAccordionItem`/`FaqAccordionSection` from `@/components/patterns/FaqAccordion` — never hand-declare an equivalent local shape.

i18n sites: FAQ text lives in `src/locales/{lang}/faq.json`; `src/data/faq.tsx` exports a `getFaqSections(t)` adapter that resolves it into canonical types (see `roversreturndogrescue/src/data/faq.tsx` for the reference implementation, including embedded `<Trans>` links).
Non-i18n sites: `src/data/faq.ts` exports `faqSections: FaqAccordionSection[]` (or `faqItems: FaqAccordionItem[]` for a single flat list) directly, as this page's own `src/data/faq.ts` does.
`FAQPage` JSON-LD must be computed from the same sections the page renders, via `buildFaqJsonLd()` in `src/lib/faq-json-ld.ts` — never hand-typed as a second, separately-maintained array.
Never attach `FAQPage` JSON-LD to a page that doesn't actually render the corresponding Q&A content.
This is distinct from the no-JS/accessibility standard at `/standards/faq-disclosure` — both apply to a live FAQ page, neither substitutes for the other.
